status: Accepted OMF Original Bin owner/name/blank/retention rules. Kind and remaining OMF fields under review.

authorization.source: Direct human reply immediately following the Original Bin proposal
authorization.statement: Sounds ok! Are you sure all this work we're doing for new scanner & parsers is genuinely GOOD work?
authorization.interpretation: The opening assent accepts the preceding Original Bin proposal. The following quality question and subsequent clarification establish the engineering objective; they do not introduce new Original Bin behavior.
authorization.scope: Selected master own _ORG_BIN reference, usable binNameUTF8 first, separate legacy MacRoman fallback, blank without usable association/name, compact selected-name retention and no stored bin ID. No runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, final cross-source priorities or new header-opening trigger.

agreedBellaRules.scope: Name-only Original Bin from an already-read supported legacy OMF. No runtime code/cutover, Bin Filter change, final source priority or new header-open trigger. MXF Original Bin fallback remains blank.
agreedBellaRules.owner: Use the same selected master as Clip Name/full-ID association; its Clip Name text may be empty. Read only its own exact _ORG_BIN Kind3 object reference, safely resolved to an MCBR bin record.
agreedBellaRules.names: Prefer usable exact binNameUTF8 as strict known UTF-8. Missing/empty/individually unreadable modern name permits the separate binName decoded as MacRoman. Never reinterpret damaged modern bytes as legacy. Preserve characters/spelling/case/punctuation/whitespace with bounded supported string framing.
agreedBellaRules.validation: Require supported reference, owner, target class and string type/representation. Equal repetitions can agree; conflicting usable same-priority values or ambiguous bin references give no usable field. A usable Unicode name outranks a different legacy spelling. General OMF damage boundaries remain later.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Keep OMF contribution unavailable and OMF-only table blank when no usable association/name; preserve physical row, master and independent facts. No file/source/nested-import/other-master/loaded-bin/filesystem substitute.
agreedBellaRules.retention: One owned selected QString and necessary compact availability/selected-owner context. Skip stored bin-ID words for this display requirement; release temporary name/reference data. No permanent raw bin object, second spelling, Bin ID or alternate-bin history.
